namespaces.name: pipeline
namespaces.description: Submit one video path and let the 7-worker pipeline run over Kafka

namespaces.name: workers
namespaces.description: Run ONE worker synchronously — the answer is the HTTP response, nothing is published to Kafka

args.description: Path to the video, as the AI services (172.17.12.80:8821-8825) will open it. Forwarded untouched; resolved locally first when the same file is mounted here (VIDEO_SEARCH_DIRS: videos/, data/).
Message id. Both aggregators (W6, W7) regroup their branches by it, so it must be unique per submission. Generated when omitted.
Name W7 writes the record under: '<name without extension>_analysis.json' in OUTPUT_DIR. Defaults to the video file name.
Per-submit overrides for the transcribe service (:8824). Recognised keys: language, task, format, transcription_level, dialog_timestamps. Anything else is ignored; omitted keys fall back to .env.
The video to run the worker on. Required unless you supply 'message' instead.
Name for this run — it labels every log line. Generated when omitted.
Video name, as the pipeline would carry it. Defaults to the file name in 'path'.
Overrides for the transcribe service (:8824): language, task, format, transcription_level, dialog_timestamps.

true (default): run the upstream workers first, so this worker receives the message its own topic would have carried — calling 'aggregator' therefore runs the whole pipeline synchronously. false: feed it 'message' (or the body itself) untouched.
false (default): the final aggregator prints its record but does not write output/<video>_analysis.json, so a trial run overwrites nothing. true: write it, as the pipeline does.
Feed the worker this exact message instead of building one — the shape its topic carries. Implies chain=false. Use it to drive an aggregator with branches you assembled yourself.
